title: Add studdy to learn
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [studdy](https://bharkodat-ux.github.io/studdy) to learn
- studdy generates personalized study guides, interactive flashcards, and quizzes to help you study topics. It provides study companion content for faster learning.

Fixes #11055

gist.headline: Study buds in bloom
gist.blurb: Studdy joined the learn garden with personalized study guides, interactive flashcards, and quizzes. Polli has packed a tiny backpack and is pretending this counts as studying.
gist.summary: Added Studdy to the app catalog and Learn section, giving learners a community-built tool that generates personalized study guides, interactive flashcards, and quizzes for any topic.
gist.impact: People exploring pollinations apps can now find Studdy as a ready-made study companion for turning topics into structured learning material.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Studdy as a cozy digital study nook: a retro terminal displays a personalized study guide, while oversized flashcards and a small quiz sheet grow like code-plants from flower pots. Polli wears a tiny scholar cap and helps arrange the cards; the eager CRT Monitor Robot can hold up a card, reinforcing interactive learning and discovery.
gist.image_prompt: A cozy pixel art study garden where Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light-blue wings, and a tiny scholar cap, helps a CRT monitor robot arrange personalized study-guide pages, flashcards, and a quiz sheet growing from lime green (#ecf874) flower pots beside a warm retro computer. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes; subtle pixel-font text on one card reads “STUDDY,” with flowers and code-vines around the desk.
